comment: None of this module's jacks carries a name in the installed build: the maker added input and output tooltips in the commit after this one, so hovering a jack here shows nothing. The polyphony channel count is taken from the pitch jack alone, so a polyphonic cable at the external input on its own still gives a monophonic output. No family is set on the external input or the output because both carry whatever the patch puts through them.
